title: Apple Unveils New Products Under Ternus | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 9/9/2026
description:
Apple unveiled a new lineup of products Wednesday, including a foldable iPhone, the company's first product launch under its new CEO John Ternus. Bloomberg Intelligence's Mandeep Singh and Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow discuss the new iPhone Duo and what the announcement says about Ternus' leadership. Then, Economist and Financial Insyght President Peter Atwater, who coined the phrase 'K-Shaped Economy', reacts to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said it's now a 'C-Shaped' economy. Finally, Michel Conrath, JPMorgan Asset Management Chief Retirement Strategist updates us on what workers in the back half of their careers should be looking at in their portfolios as they prepare for retirement.
